title: Renderer-side Supabase data-access module (supabase-data.js)
context: Issue #277-C of the S2-hybrid migration. Creates src/js/supabase-data.js — a renderer-side module that performs all project/data CRUD directly via the Supabase JS client (supabase.from(...)/supabase.rpc(...)) under the signed-in user's JWT so that RLS is enforced end-to-end. Replaces the current apiFetch('/api/...') → Python sidecar (psycopg) path. THIS SUB-ISSUE ONLY creates the module + unit tests; wiring into call sites is 277-D.

criteria.text: sdGetProjects() calls from('projects').select(...).order('updated_at', {ascending:false}) and returns the unwrapped data array; throws on error.
criteria.test_id: sdGetProjects > calls projects.select with the correct columns and returns data

criteria.text: sdGetProject(id) calls from('projects').select(...).eq('id', id).single() and returns the single project; throws on error.
criteria.test_id: sdGetProject > calls projects table with eq(id) and returns a single project

criteria.text: sdSaveProject(project) calls from('projects').upsert(payload, {onConflict:'id'}) with the correct fields (id, name, state, owner_user_id, workspace_id, visibility); throws on error.
criteria.test_id: sdSaveProject > upserts project with the correct columns

criteria.text: sdDeleteProject(id) calls from('projects').delete().eq('id', id); throws on error.
criteria.test_id: sdDeleteProject > calls delete on projects table with the project id

criteria.text: sdTransferProject(projectId, toUserId) calls rpc('transfer_project_owner', { p_project_id, p_to_user_id }) with the correct RPC param names (from 277-B); throws on error.
criteria.test_id: sdTransferProject > calls rpc transfer_project_owner with the correct param names

criteria.text: sdGetProjectHistory(id) calls from('project_revisions').select(...).eq('project_id', id).order('revision_number', {ascending:false}); throws on error.
criteria.test_id: sdGetProjectHistory > queries project_revisions with the project_id filter

criteria.text: sdRestoreProject(id, revisionNumber) fetches the revision snapshot from project_revisions and upserts its state back into projects; throws when revision not found.
criteria.test_id: sdRestoreProject > fetches the revision state and upserts it as the current project state

criteria.text: sdGetAnnouncements() calls from('announcements').select(...).order('created_at', {ascending:true}) and returns the data array; throws on error.
criteria.test_id: sdGetAnnouncements > queries the announcements table and returns the data array

criteria.text: sdSaveAnnouncements(data) calls from('announcements').upsert(rows) with the correct fields; throws on error.
criteria.test_id: sdSaveAnnouncements > upserts each announcement with the required fields

criteria.text: sdGetSongs() calls from('songs').select(...).order('title', {ascending:true}) and returns the data array; throws on error.
criteria.test_id: sdGetSongs > queries the songs table ordered by title

criteria.text: sdSaveSongs(data) calls from('songs').upsert(rows) without calling delete (additive, mirrors save_songs in storage.py); throws on error.
criteria.test_id: sdSaveSongs > upserts songs without deleting existing rows

criteria.text: sdGetSettings() calls from('workspace_settings').select('workspace_id, settings') and returns the row(s); throws on error.
criteria.test_id: sdGetSettings > queries workspace_settings and returns the settings blob

criteria.text: sdSaveSettings(settings) calls from('workspace_settings').upsert({settings}) with the settings object; throws on error.
criteria.test_id: sdSaveSettings > upserts into workspace_settings with the settings blob

criteria.text: sdGetMembers() calls from('workspace_members').select('user_id, role, profiles(display_name, email)') and returns the data; throws on error.
criteria.test_id: sdGetMembers > queries workspace_members with profiles join

criteria.text: sdGetPresence(projectId) calls from('workspace_presences').select(...).eq('project_id', projectId) and returns the data; throws on error.
criteria.test_id: sdGetPresence > queries workspace_presences filtered by project_id

criteria.text: sdPostPresenceHeartbeat(projectId) calls from('workspace_presences').upsert({project_id, last_seen_at}) with the project_id; throws on error.
criteria.test_id: sdPostPresenceHeartbeat > upserts a presence row for the given project_id

criteria.text: sdDeletePresence({userId}) calls from('workspace_presences').delete().eq('user_id', userId); throws on error.
criteria.test_id: sdDeletePresence > deletes workspace_presences for the current user

criteria.text: sdGetTemplates() calls from('templates').select('id, name, template_data, is_default') with is_default DESC, name ASC ordering; throws on error.
criteria.test_id: sdGetTemplates > queries the templates table ordered by is_default desc, name asc

criteria.text: sdSaveTemplates(data) filters out default/built-in templates (is_default, built_in, builtIn) before upserting; throws on error.
criteria.test_id: sdSaveTemplates > upserts non-default templates only (skips built-ins)

criteria.text: node --check src/js/supabase-data.js passes with no syntax errors.
criteria.test_id: node --check

not_tested: LIMITATION: sdRestoreProject does not enforce a CAS check on client_revision (the Python handler uses save_project_transactional with WHERE revision=?). For conflict-safe restore, wire through a Postgres function in 277-D.

LIMITATION: sdSaveAnnouncements is upsert-only (not DELETE+INSERT). The Python handler does a full workspace replacement (DELETE WHERE workspace_id=? then INSERT all). Full-replace via supabase-js requires two round-trips or an RPC — flagged for 277-D.

LIMITATION: sdGetPresence does not enforce the 90-second TTL filter at the DB level. The Python handler uses WHERE last_seen_at > now() - interval '90 seconds'. With supabase-js this requires .gt('last_seen_at', isoTimestamp) — caller must apply the filter, or use an RPC in 277-D.

LIMITATION: sdSaveSettings requires workspace_id to be passed explicitly from session context. The Python handler resolves workspace_id from the authenticated user's claims — 277-D must supply it from the session.
LIMITATION: sdDeletePresence without a userId arg will delete all presence rows for the user (no workspace_id filter). Production callers must pass userId from session — flagged for 277-D.
LIVE RLS round-trip: real network call with a signed JWT to verify RLS policies scope data to the authenticated user's workspace — manual smoke only.
LIVE: sdTransferProject via a real DB with transfer_project_owner RPC installed — requires 277-B RPC to be applied.
